title: Baltic anomaly history: lightning, smoke, NATO ships

tellings.quote: Lightning has struck the object, smoke has been seen coming out, NATO ships are circling it, super strange.

plain: A strange object lies in the Baltic Sea, and according to Michels lightning has struck it, smoke has been seen coming out of it, and ships from NATO, the Western military alliance, have circled it. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and calls it "super strange". If true, it would mean military forces were paying close attention to something odd on the seabed.
